messages:
Rae (CS): Quick ping— several onboarding tenants reported that newly created embeddings weren't searchable and some ingestion calls returned 5xx between 03:0503:20 UTC. Customers want status + remediation plan. We should offer proactive enablement and a make-good. Victor, status?
Victor (Eng): Triage: a config migration changed chunk checksum handling; older chunk writes failed validation which caused retries and intermittent overload on ingestion workers. We've paused the migration, requeued failed batches, and are running targeted replays. No signs of data loss or external access.
Lina (SRE): Rolling replays and throttling in place to protect downstream. Replay progress 38% (job bf-1766-01). Expected catch-up 2-4h depending on peak. Dashboard: https://internal.metrics/embeds/1766. Incident INC-1766 opened.
Zoe (AM): Proposed external note for impacted accounts: 'We're investigating an ingestion issue that affected some newly-created embeddings. Engineering has mitigated the root cause and is replaying affected data; we expect full restoration within a few hours. No customer data exposure. As a courtesy we'll apply a billing credit and schedule a complimentary enablement session to validate your ingest jobs.' Recommend offering: one week of free usage credit (applied as invoice credit) + a 30-min technical clinic. Any objections?
Rae (CS): Sounds good. Also request customers to share failing job ids and whether they used batched or streaming ingestion. Ask if they'd like us to run a prioritized replay on their behalf (requires consent).
Victor (Eng): For teams that opt-in to prioritized replay, include header X-CS-Consent: true in the support ticket so SRE can map and expedite. Quick self-check for customers after we announce recovery: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"health-check"}' | jq '.status'``` expecting "ok" and a subsequent search hit within 30s.
AlertBot: Incident rollback completed at 03:22 UTC. All ingestion pipelines reporting normal. INC-1766 status: mitigated. RCA draft assigned to Eng/SRE; public RCA ETA 48h.
Rae (CS): Action items: 1) Zoe send personalized comms + apply one-week credit to impacted tenants 2) CS collect job ids and consent flags in tracker https://docs.internal/cs/inc-1766-feedback 3) Eng/SRE finalize RCA and post to #postmortems 4) Offer two live office hours sessions this week for troubleshooting. I'll follow up here with any customer replies.
Zoe (AM): Sending now to top 12 impacted tenants and flagging any accounts with renewals in next 90 days for AM outreach. Will paste replies here.
Lina (SRE): Replay progress 72%. No new validator errors. Will post final confirmation when backfills finish.
Rae (CS): Thanks all. Please escalate any customers who report inability to validate after we confirm recovery.
